ana: Heads-up: planned rolling reboots + NIC firmware swap in rack-42 (us-east1) Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC. We'll do cohort drains to limit latency spikes.

liam: What's the capacity impact and any pinned tenants?

ana: Rack-42 = 8 GPUs across 4 nodes. Cohorts of 1 node (2 GPUs) so transient capacity dip ~10-15%. No hard-pinned tenants but two high-traffic customers have soft-affinity in the region.

ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-2128 created. Preflight scheduled Tue 02:30 UTC.

cheng: Recommend canary: cordon n42-01, drain low-priority, run perf probe 10m, then proceed. Also disable KV priming on cohort nodes 20m before cordon.

liam: Add routing fallback to us-central for stateless requests. Cost impact minimal for 30m.

sre-lead: Preflight checklist: verify firmware SHA256, confirm KMS access for cross-region fallback, validate rollback images. If p95>250ms for >5m abort.

ana: Runbook snippet: `kubectl cordon n42-01 && kubectl drain n42-01 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=300` then run `perf-check.sh`.

cheng: Ops note: attach firmware sha256 and vendor release notes to INFRA-2128.

liam: I'll draft tenant comms and post 4h before window.

ana: TL;DR: Tue 03:00-04:00 UTC rack-42 rolling reboot+NIC firmware. Canary cohorts, KV priming off, preflight 02:30 UTC. INFRA-2128 contains runbook and hashes.
